stages.blurb: Chapters 1–4 and the final mission. Every chapter and named-mission trophy pops as you play — nothing here can be missed by just finishing the story. Before the final mission, clear the one-shot chances on the Missables page.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.blurb: The people of Leonida: five contact strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), the 8 stranger strands, Bret's hunt and the 9 activity types sampler. Answer contacts as their missions open and stop for every stranger marker you pass.
stages.title: Strangers & side missions

stages.blurb: The skill trophies: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 20 race wins, 14 drone-race locations, beating Cal at fishing, one arcade game, 50 challenges, meditation at 18 spots, and bowling. A few per session — never a wall.
stages.title: Activities & skills

stages.blurb: Explore all 52 areas, discover 100 vehicles, register 10 to Scooter Bros, complete 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, buy all 8 garages, and have the Ocean Beach cocktail. Fold these into exploration, region by region.
stages.title: Collectibles & the map

stages.blurb: The partner moments, the robberies (5 bank vaults, armored trucks, one illegal operation per gang), the strange encounters, the money totals ($250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent), the 500 choices — and then 100% completion and the platinum.
stages.title: Money, mayhem & cleanup
